arabic text: SUGHRA KO RULATA HAI, YE CHAAND MUHARRAM KA
english translation text: This moon of Muharram brings Sughra to tears.

arabic text: JAB SAMNAY AATA HAI, YE CHAAND MUHARRAM KA
english translation text: Whenever it appears before her, this moon of Muharram.

arabic text: HUM SURAT E ZAHRA SE, BHAI KE BICHARNAY KI.\nKHATOON E QAYAMAT KAY, GHAR BAR UJAR NE KI\nRUDAAD SUNATA HAI, YE CHAAND MUHARRAM KA
english translation text:
It recounts the sorrow of a sister separated from her brother,
The tragedy of the Lady of Judgment whose household was destroyed.
This moon of Muharram tells that tale.

arabic text: KATA HAI GALA LOGON, SEHROZ KE PYAASE KA.\nPAMAAL HUA LAASHA, AHMAD KE NAWASAY KA\nHAR IK KO BATATAA HAI. YE CHAAND MUHARRAM KA
english translation text:
People, it reminds us of the severed throat of the three-day thirsty one,
And of the trampled body of the Prophet's grandson.
This moon of Muharram tells everyone of it.

arabic text: TASWEER DIKHATA HAI, AHMAD KI JAWANI KI.\nHAR SHAKS KO DUNIYA MAI, KARBAL KI KAHANI KI\nTAFSEER BATATAA HAI, YE CHAAND MUHARRAM KA
english translation text:
It paints a picture of the youthful beauty of Ahmad's family,
And explains to every person in the world
The story and meaning of Karbala.

arabic text: KARBAL KI ZIYAARAT KO, JO AANKH TARAPTI THI.\nSHABBIR TERAY GHUM MAI, JO AANKH BARASTI THI\nUS AANKH KO BHAATA HAI, YE CHAAND MUHARRAM KA
english translation text:
The eye that longed for the ziyarat of Karbala,
The eye that poured tears in grief for Shabbir,
Is drawn to this moon of Muharram.

arabic text: IMRAN KO SHABBAR KO, KHATOON E QAYAMAT KO.\nHAIDAR KI KASAM MAZHAR, SARKAR E RISALAT KO\nTURBAT MAI RULATA HAI, YE CHAAND MUHARRAM KA
english translation text:
By Allah, it makes Imran weep, it makes Shabbar weep,
It makes the Lady of Judgment weep, and by Haider's oath, O Mazhar,
It even makes the Messenger of Allah weep within his grave—this moon of Muharram.
